channel.title: Emergency and critical care medicine
channel.description: Medical bulletin portal with the latest verified evidence across 15 specialties: vascular surgery, general surgery, OB/GYN, pediatrics, cardiology, internal medicine, neurology, oncology, orthopedics, urology, gastroenterology, nephrology, pulmonology, endocrinology and emergency medicine. Full text and a short audio newscast for every issue.
